verdict.rationale: Docs show ACH origination via POST /ach_transfers with credit/debit support, same-day ACH windows (all 3 Fed windows), webhook-driven lifecycle tracking, and returns automatically correlated to originating transfers, plus sandbox simulation of ACH events. However, the pack never explicitly names Notification of Change (NOC) or reversal objects as first-class API entities, only 'returns' are called out. Missing for 10: explicit NOC object/webhook documentation, explicit reversal object/webhook documentation.
